description: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes of six multilingual BERT models—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine linguistic categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these linguistic categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis represents the effect size, scaled linearly from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of six bars, one for each model, color-coded as follows: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Error bars indicate the standard deviation or confidence interval for each bar’s value. The effect sizes vary significantly across categories and models; for example, in the IE-Indic category, the mBERT-R₂ bar reaches approximately 20, while the XLM-B₂ bar reaches approximately 22. In contrast, for the Isolate category, all bars are very short, with values below 2. The Semitic category shows the highest overall effect sizes, with the XLM-B₂ bar reaching approximately 20 and the XLM-L₂ bar reaching approximately 15. The bars are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
